title: Sensibilidade e dado pessoal
known_constraints: the official scope is a column and the declared dependency is quality
the canonical output is sensitivity, not semantic_type

the official blueprint requests converging evidence for sensitivity and personal-data classification but does not define an executable condition, vocabulary, exclusions, confidence, evidence, questions, tests or calibration

the engine already has transient sensitive-header signals for CPF, CNPJ, email, name, phone, mobile and address, plus independent workbook masking; the new rule must not weaken, duplicate or expose those controls
